name: Clive Lagrene
source:
Likes: Stationary
Dislikes: Thinking about what to wear
Hobby: Brewing coffee
Skill: None

"You really are my single light of hope in the darkness."

Lars: I'll be introducing Clive!
He's my younger twin brother, and we entered the academy at the same time.
The Night Class, by the way.
He's always dependable and is nice to everyone.
He often tags along with me when I go shopping, and is seriously an all-around perfect guy.
The casse-croute and coffee he makes are top-notch, so let's go try it out together someday.
He's also always taking notes, so he's your man to go to if you forget your plans.
But lately he's been acting glum. He doesn't seem to be sleeping at night, and has been avoiding me ever since arriving at the academy.
Hey, we're twins!
If he has something on his mind, he should confide in me and we can solve it together!

[Official in-game description]
